experiments.scope: Exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 root compression on 64-byte single-block messages, digests computed only by the submitted grouped partial evaluator (group setup + 247-operation inner body). Per organizer seed: 32 seed-derived 15-word prefixes x y = m15 in 0..31, N_t = 1024 = 2^10 messages, 20-bit digest-XOR mask spread over all eight output words (bits 0,13,26 of o0..o3; bits 5,21 of o4..o7). All 256 trials returned, including failures.
experiments.hypothesis: (1) Every returned pair is a genuine masked match of the trusted blake3-r2 digest, so the grouped evaluator computes the exact digest. (2) The success frequency of this scaled analogue (N_t^2/2 = 2^w/2, the same ratio as N = 2^128 for 256 bits) is consistent with the random-function value 1 - prod_{i<1024}(1 - i/2^20) = 0.3933 that heuristic H1 assumes at full width. Finite frequencies are supporting evidence, not a certified population probability.

experiments.scope: Same evaluator and target; per organizer seed one seed-derived prefix with consecutive y = m15 in 0..1023 (all N_t = 1024 messages inside one group, the most structured case), 20-bit digest-XOR mask on different positions (bits 7,30 of o0..o3; bits 2,15,28 of o4..o7). All 256 trials returned, including failures.
experiments.hypothesis: Within-group digests, where only m15 varies by small consecutive values, show no masked-collision excess or deficit relative to the random-function value 0.3933; the grouped structure does not change the birthday behaviour that H1 assumes.
